title: Steady-state cushion provisioning and pricing stress test (June 2026)
content:
Executive summary:

This working sheet lays out a steady-state provisioning cushion (months of reserved capacity) and runs a compact pricing sensitivity sweep against headcount plans and runway. The aim is to produce a small set of decision levers for Finance + Ops to reduce burn or hold SLA while product/eng triage capacity optimizations. NOT final; rough numbers and TODOs throughout.

Purpose:
- Create a defensible default cushion policy for steady-state hosted demand (target: X months reserved GPU capacity) and map how pricing moves ripple to hiring and runway.
- Produce a simple sensitivity table that PMs/EngOps can use during spike events to evaluate pricing vs HC trade-offs.

Key assumptions (baseline):
- Time period: steady monthly view, months aligned to fiscal quarters. Baseline month = May 2026 run-rate.
- Monthly hosted token consumption (baseline): 12B tokens total (mix of gen + embeddings; embedding units normalized to token-equivalent).
- Average cost to serve (baseline): $0.0038 per 1k tokens (includes infra, storage, licensing amortized for hosted).
- Average price (list) charged: $0.008 per 1k tokens (blended across customers / feature tiers).
- Dedicated / reserved capacity per-month amortized cost per GPU pool: $180k per pool (includes infra and ops).
- Headcount: current finance-plan HC (ops + SRE + infra) = 48 FTEs in hosting/infra cost center. Average loaded cost per FTE = $220k/year -> $18.33k/month.
- Cushion target candidates: 0, 1, 2, 3 months of reserved capacity (months of peak monthly equivalent).

Baseline math (rounded):
- Baseline monthly cost to serve tokens = 12,000M tokens / 1k * $0.0038 = $45.6k (note: simplifying, some fixed pool costs separate)
- Baseline monthly revenue = 12,000M/1k * $0.008 = $96k
- Baseline gross margin (token-level) = 96k - 45.6k = $50.4k (52.5%)
- Fixed hosting reserved pool(s) and HC currently = $1.8M/month (includes dedicated pools, infra ops HC allocation, network) — this dominates token marginal cost for larger customers.

Cushion sizing tradeoffs (illustrative):
- Cushion = number of months of additional reserved pool capacity we keep idle to handle spikes before bursting: 0/1/2/3 months.
- Each 1 month cushion = +$180k/month hit to fixed cost (amortized across committed billing) if we pre-warm a pool.

Scenario sweep (table):
Columns: scenario | cushion months | extra monthly fixed | monthly burn delta | price shock | implied gross margin | hc reduction needed to hit -10% burn
- Conservative | 3 | +$540k | +$540k | -10% price | margin falls ~ -18ppts | ~12 FTE
- Baseline | 1 | +$180k | +$180k | 0% price | baseline margin | ~4 FTE
- Aggressive | 0 | +$0 | 0 | +5% price (targeted promo) | margin +5ppts | none

Pricing sensitivity quick matrix (selected cells):
- Price delta (relative): -15%, -10%, -5%, 0%, +5%, +10%, +20%
- For each: compute monthly revenue, token-margin, net burn impact, approximate HC delta required (rounded):

Sample numbers (baseline cushion=1 month):
- Price -15%: revenue = $81.6k, token margin = 81.6k - 45.6k = 36k, total fixed = 1.98M -> gross negative margin increases; required HC cut to salvage 10% burn = 16 FTE (~$293k/month saving)
- Price -10%: revenue = $86.4k, token margin = 40.8k, HC cut needed for -10% burn = 12 FTE (~$220k/month)
- Price -5%: revenue = $91.2k, token margin = 45.6k, HC cut needed ~6 FTE
- Price 0%: revenue = $96k, token margin = 50.4k, HC cut needed ~4 FTE (to meet burn schedule if cushion=3)
- Price +5%: revenue = $100.8k, token margin = 55.2k, HC change = +0 to +2 (allows hiring in Q3)
- Price +20%: revenue = $115.2k, margin = 69.6k, runway extended ~2 months

Headcount phasing (finance-ops hosting org) - rough plan: 
Q3 2026 hires (planned): 6 hires (3 infra engineers, 2 SRE, 1 capacity planner) -> run-rate +$110k/month loaded
Q4 2026 hires (deferred candidate): 4 hires (tiered) -> +$74k/month loaded if approved
Hiring freeze trigger: if price decline >10% sustained for 2 months OR cushion spend + permanent reserve >$360k/month then freeze.
Severance buffer: 3 months of headcount ramp assumed for cost tie-out.

Sensitivity notes and caveats:
- Many costs are lumpy (reserved pools) — marginal token cost understates fixed hosting risk. Small token-level margins can be erased by one extra reserved pool.
- This sweep uses simple proportional revenue change; in reality price changes affect demand elasticity and feature mix (embeddings vs generation).
- We have not modeled delayed churn or new ARR lost from rate increases; those require customer-level elasticity curves (ask Growth/RevOps).

Short table (compact budgeting view) - monthly aggregated (numbers rounded):
Month | Tokens (B) | Token margin ($k) | Fixed hosting ($k) | HC payroll ($k) | Net operating burn ($k)
May26 | 12.0 | 50.4 | 1800 | 880 | 2629.6
Jun26 (baseline cushion=1) | 12.2 | 51.2 | 1980 | 890 | 2928.8
Jul26 (cushion=2 add pool) | 11.8 | 49.1 | 2160 | 900 | 3010.9

Operational playbook (draft):
- If price shock <-10% observed: trigger hiring freeze + immediate capacity thrift review (JIRA FIN-1129) + 2-week repricing experiment for non-enterprise tiers.
- If cushion increases to >=2 months: require Exec approval (Finance + CTO) and commit to 90-day review to measure utilization.
- When cushion is decreased: require runbook to warm pools (lead time ~3 weeks) + communications to SRE schedule.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Get accurate per-model token costs by model/seq-length (ACTION: Eng-Infra to provide model breakdown — JIRA ENG-2045).
- Elasticity coefficients by customer tier (Growth to produce 90-day experimental data).
- Confirm average loaded HC cost by sub-team (People Ops).
- Validate dedicated pool amortization with Release Eng (pool replacement/refresh cadence).

Notes to reviewers:
- This sheet synthesizes fixed-lumpy infra (reserved pools) with marginal token economics to help operations. Metrics are intentionally simplified to be understandable and actionable by GTM and Finance.
- Please annotate with scenario you think is closest to reality and add linked tickets (use the Linked Artifacts list or append).

Action items (next 10 days):
- Miguel: pull per-model cost report (due 2026-06-24) -> JIRA ENG-2045
- Priya: test 2-tier promo at +5% price for lower-tier customers and report delta (start 2026-06-28) -> CONFLUENCE-PRICING-TESTS page
- Noah: finalize HC loaded cost table by 2026-06-25 and merge to payroll model (github.com/redwood-inference/finance-models/pull/52)

Appendix (raw sensitivity snapshot):
- Assumption list (rates, pools, loads) included in comments above.
- Quick reproducible formula: revenue = tokens/1k * price_per_1k; token_cost = tokens/1k * cost_per_1k; fixed_total = base_fixed + cushion_months * pool_cost; net = revenue - token_cost - fixed_total - HC_payroll.

Longer-term suggestions:
- Introduce seasonal pricing bands for embedding-heavy customers to protect margins.
- Build a small runbook automation that flags when reserved pool idle utilization < 35% for 45 days and alerts Infra/Product to repool capacity.

Document history / notes: draft assembled by Aisha Raman (finance) with inputs from Eng and People Ops; sits in drive as working item for Q3 planning.
